d: Chennaiyin FC and Kerala Blasters FC played out a goalless draw at the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in Chennai. Both sides created scoring opportunities but were unable to find the breakthrough despite some close attempts. Adrian Luna missed a penalty for Kerala Blasters, while Amrinder Singh made crucial saves to keep Kerala Blasters in the match. The contest ended on a dramatic note, with Andre Green and Emmanuel Imanishimwe receiving red cards in stoppage time.
